evidence: The data listed in Tables I and II also indicate that the color of CaS:Pb phosphor more strongly depended on the cycle number of PbS deposition rather than TPbS . Colors of samples A–C shifted to green compared to the samples D–G, although the TPbS of samples A–C were thinner than those of samples D–G as shown in Tables I and II. The reason must be because the numbers of cycles for samples A–C were larger than those of samples D–G, and the repeated cycle of PbS deposition enhanced the formation of agglomerates.
